title: Pharaoh's Threats and the Signs of Punishment

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh threatened the magicians for believing without his permission. He said he would cut off their hands and feet and crucify them. They said, "We will return to our Lord." They prayed for patience and to die as Muslims.

Pharaoh said he would kill the sons of Moses' people. Moses told his people to seek help from Allah and be patient. The earth belongs to Allah. The best end is for the righteous. Perhaps Allah would destroy their enemy.

Allah seized Pharaoh's people with years of famine and few fruits. When bad came, they blamed Moses. So Allah sent the flood, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood. They begged Moses to pray and promised to believe. But when the punishment was removed, they broke their word. So Allah drowned them in the sea.

Allah gave the oppressed people the blessed lands in the east and west, because of their patience. He destroyed what Pharaoh had built. After crossing the sea, the Children of Israel saw people devoted to idols. They asked Moses for an idol like those. Moses said, "You are behaving ignorantly."

hardWords.m: a time when there is very little food
